hero.title: Products Built for Commercial Growers
hero.description: InnovoGrow delivers high-performance LED lighting solutions designed for commercial cultivation, led by top-light performance and supported by linear indoor and under-canopy options that help maximize yield, quality, and operational efficiency.

features.title: Engineered for Maximum Yield
features.text: Uniform light placement across the canopy.

features.title: Reliable, Scalable & Future-Ready
features.text: Built for commercial rooms and expansion.

features.title: Backed by Expert Support
features.text: Layout guidance for real facility workflows.

products.title: IG 300-D1 - Top Light
products.description: Simplify your top-lighting layout with one driver architecture that powers up to 80 fixtures, reducing cost, complexity, and installation time.

benefits.title: One Driver Architecture
benefits.text: Power up to 80 fixtures with a single driver.

benefits.title: Cost Effective
benefits.text: Fewer drivers, less wiring, lower installation cost.

benefits.title: Scalable by Design
benefits.text: Easily expand as your operation grows.

benefits.title: Versatile
benefits.text: Ideal for racks, greenhouses, and large rooms.

products.title: IG 800 - Linear Indoor LED
products.description: Flexible linear lighting for indoor cultivation, with versatile applications, high performance, and superior light quality.

benefits.title: Premium Build
benefits.text: Durable aluminum body with IP66 rating.

products.title: IG 330 - Linear Indoor LED
products.description: A dedicated linear indoor LED for vegetative rooms, early-stage crop development, and cultivation zones that need broad, uniform coverage with a clean overhead layout.

benefits.title: Built for Veg Spaces
benefits.text: Designed for vegetative development and uniform room coverage.

benefits.title: Broad Linear Spread
benefits.text: Supports even light placement across benches and indoor layouts.

benefits.title: Clean Facility Integration
benefits.text: Fits commercial indoor rooms with a streamlined linear fixture profile.

benefits.title: Spec Support Available
benefits.text: Talk to our team for fixture selection, layout guidance, and technical details.

products.title: IG 150 - Under Canopy LED
products.description: A dedicated under-canopy support fixture engineered to improve lower-zone distribution in top-light rooms for stronger plant uniformity and more complete crop development.

benefits.title: Lower-Zone Support
benefits.text: Improves light delivery beneath dense top-light canopies.

benefits.title: Higher Yields
benefits.text: Supports stronger lower growth and more complete crop performance.

benefits.title: Simple Integration
benefits.text: Easy to deploy as a companion layer in top-light rooms.

benefits.title: Commercial Ready
benefits.text: Built for demanding facility use and long operating cycles.

cta.title: Not sure which product is right for your facility?
cta.description: Our lighting experts will design a custom solution tailored to your crop, layout, and goals.
